### [Tino Cuellar joins Anthropic as Chief Global Affairs Officer](https://www.anthropic.com/news/tino-cuellar)

**Anthropic** · 2026-08-04

Anthropic has hired Mariano-Florentino (Tino) Cu&#x27;ellar as its first Chief Global Affairs Officer to lead international engagement, policy, and government relationships.

- Cu&#x27;ellar previously served as President of the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, a Justice of the Supreme Court of California, and co-led California&#x27;s Frontier AI Working Group.
- He was a Trustee of Anthropic&#x27;s Long-Term Benefit Trust starting in January 2026 and stepped down from that role to join the executive team.
- His mandate includes managing global government relationships, advising on frontier AI regulation, and engaging with democratic policymakers on AI economics and security.

**Why it matters:** The appointment strengthens Anthropic&#x27;s capacity to navigate complex global regulatory environments and influence democratic AI governance policy.
